mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through lower cost of capital for corporations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% over 3 months signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0% for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is above -0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 6-month moving averages indicate robust consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through improved earnings expectations.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both above 6-month moving average
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS are above their 6-month moving averages, or the interaction term (HOUST * RSAFS) has a Rank IC below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%), a higher federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and returns in high inflation regimes is above -0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) indicates elevated inflation that prompts Federal Reserve rate hikes and erodes real corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL is above its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is above -0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) below 50,000 jobs signals labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS growth is below 50,000 jobs per month, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is above -0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In regimes where housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1,300 thousand units and industrial production (INDPRO) exceeds 104, consumer demand is robust, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through sustained economic expansion.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST > 1300 and INDPRO > 104, or the Rank IC between HOUST and returns in this regime is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) reflects robust manufacturing activity and supply chain strength that supports economic growth and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO is above its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
